suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment associated risk. Require esophageal cancer treated with thoracic radiotherapy and incident atrial fibrillation/qualifying arrhythmia after radiation exposure. Treatment-associated cardiotoxicity evidence; do not infer AF from esophageal cancer without thoracic RT. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation of the qualifying treatment or procedure used for Esophageal Cancer
Independent diagnosis of Cardiac Arrhythmias (Atrial Fibrillation, Tachycardia) and timing relative to that exposure
Dose, duration, procedure details, and relevant co-exposures where applicable
Qualified clinical assessment of competing causes and source-phenotype fit
